subject: Question on identification names reported by MSstats

messages.author: 218408539b2945a7
messages.subject: Question on identification names reported by MSstats
parts:
Dear MSstats team,

I was converting DIA data from DIANN to MSstats. While DIANN reports the results for Genes, Protein accession numbers and Protein names as identification, the converted table reports only the Protein names in MSstats.
I was wondering if I could instead have the Gene names; do I have to select a particular option for doing so?

Thank you very much for your help and for this great tool.
Best regards,
Giovanni

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: Question on identification names reported by MSstats
parts:
Hey Giovanni,

We do not have a way to automatically do this using the converter, however it can be done pretty easily by just swapping the protein info with the gene info. You can run the code below before inputting the data into the converter, and then run your analysis as usual.

```
diann_file$Protein.Names = diann_file$Genes
```

Best,
Devon
